mechanism.name: symmetric-halo block FFT convolution
mechanism.output_semantics: same bounded float64 array as full-frame FFT reference

forbidden_fallbacks: change the P6ZA profile, kernel, dtype, row chunk, shape, fixture, run order or thread settings after observing results
exclude a slow or high-memory run
reuse the P6ZD direct separable implementation
weaken numerical, repeat, memory or time gates
claim native/mobile/GPU, measured scanner or product performance

branch_rule.pass: retain block FFT as the local CPU development compiler and open combined-chain integration measurement
branch_rule.fail: close exact Python block FFT performance and keep the full-frame FFT reference until a native implementation is justified

claim_ceiling: Local Windows/Python numerical and fresh-process resource evidence for a generic block-FFT scanner-glare compiler only; not measured scanner calibration, native/mobile/GPU performance, photographic quality or product readiness.
